question: Can a previously unused, published real POMDP benchmark run from exact upstream bytes with identical public action/consequence traces on Ubuntu and Windows, without source-private ground truth? A later test could measure acquired temporal relationship memory with genuine reward and strong conventional controls.
hypothesis: Memory Gym Mortar Mayhem and Mystery Path can supply a source-native partially observed temporal task with delayed consequences. This stage proves only source custody, mechanical action/reward generation, cross-OS determinism; it cannot establish knowledge transfer, learning, or memory necessity.

lineage.predecessor: FKP08 PR #1099 engineering PASS source-only; unique gain NO-GO against exact Bayes/conventional delta; original DEV consumed
lineage.why_distinct: Existing MiniGrid AAI07B reward learning tied conventional Beta/logistic; NS-Gym AAI08A regime cache trailed recency; this new independent real-source memory suite was not previously used in Yggdrasil and requires no artificial Boolean law family.

upstream.license_policy: Do not copy upstream source/assets into research repo; git clone source at pinned SHA to isolated scratch, install only source no-deps, preserve license and unchanged tree.

runtime.internet: only publicly hosted pinned package downloads and GitHub clone; no paid services

mechanical_protocol.policy: At each step use a fresh Python random.Random(seed XOR 91009) seeded per episode and emit [rng.randrange(3), rng.randrange(3)] matching original MultiDiscrete([3,3]) public action space; no random model or source-private info.
mechanical_protocol.observation: Use only returned source-native observation array bytes, shape, dtype, selected actions, true rewards, terminated and truncated; ignore every info field, unwrapped env, ground truth and hidden coordinates.
mechanical_protocol.receipt: SHA-256 over framed action/observation/real reward/terminated/truncated messages at each actual step; per-task and per-seed output must reproduce and match across Windows and Ubuntu, not just pass on one OS.
prechecks: Exact upstream source commit and pinned blobs match
Pygame dummy display works without desktop or human mode
4 reserved mechanical episodes per each of 2 tasks, each >=8 and <=32 actually charged native steps
No protected, DEV or TRANSFER science seeds invoked
All returned observation bytes type/shape valid and actual public reward finite
Full inherited Yggdrasil regression 54/54 and G29 source atlas PASS both OS on exact candidate source
stop: Import/installation problems are INFRA_UNVERIFIED; do not call source science fail
Cross-OS native trace divergence with pinned dependencies is SOURCE_NO_GO; no seed/action/script retune after initial trace observation
Random policy may not solve the task or earn positive rewards; source mechanistic admission alone cannot support scientific conclusions
If source requires private dynamics to make sense, report benchmark unsuitable rather than leak info to learner

requires: Freeze separate learning mechanism and disjoint public DEV/TRANSFER/NEGATIVE cohorts and true untouched source worlds
Measure actual reward/action consequence and event identifiability before claiming memory benefit
Train equal-data, action-budget and whole-process matched fully conventional GRU/other recurrent models, symbolic and ablation controls; no intentionally crippled comparison
Compare persistent native tokenless cumulative association learning, cold memory, interference, unfamiliar transfer, action value, CPU/wall/storage
Independent owner-protected science/acceptance before actual native model promotion
